name: Blackglass Credential Vault
description: A megacorp’s orbital relay is dark, but its credential vault still answers on the lab network. Recover the access key that opens the vault’s surviving record. Scan `172.20.0.0/24` for challenge hosts in `172.20.0.141-199`, then use the services’ exposed records and operational evidence to decide what to trust.

tasks.name: Open the Blackglass Vault
tasks.description: Recover the vault’s surviving record from the megacorp relay. It runs on the lab network; scan `172.20.0.0/24` (challenge hosts are in `172.20.0.141-199`) and examine the exposed service records.
hints: The service exposes both a credential inventory and operational metadata. Compare them before trying anything.
Use the inventory export time as a reference when evaluating each credential’s issue time.
The genuine credential predates the inventory snapshot. Use that record to request the vault entry.
